text: Congress Put $50 Billion Into Rural Health. Only 15% of It Can Pay Providers for Care. Congress put $50 billion into rural health. CMS then capped payments to hospitals and other providers for care at 15% of each state's award. Kevin Martin, a controller, on why most of the money cannot pay for the care it was supposed to save.
